+++ b/tests/test_async_backend_results.py
@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+import logging
+
+import pytest
+
+from structlog import make_filtering_bound_logger
+from structlog.stdlib import AsyncBoundLogger, BoundLogger
+
+
+class Backend:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.calls = []
+
+    def __getattr__(self, name):
+        def log(*args, **kwargs):
+            self.calls.append((name, args, kwargs))
+            return self
+        return log
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("style", ["native", "stdlib", "deprecated"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["debug", "info", "warning", "error", "critical", "fatal", "exception", "log"])
+async def test_async_result(style, method):
+    backend = Backend()
+    if style == "native":
+        logger = make_filtering_bound_logger(logging.DEBUG)(backend, [], {})
+    elif style == "stdlib":
+        logger = BoundLogger(backend, [], {})
+    else:
+        logger = AsyncBoundLogger(backend, [], {})
+    args = (logging.INFO, "event") if method == "log" else ("event",)
+    name = method if style == "deprecated" else "a" + method
+    assert await getattr(logger, name)(*args) is backend
+    assert len(backend.calls) == 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_filtered_native_returns_none():
+    backend = Backend()
+    logger = make_filtering_bound_logger(logging.WARNING)(backend, [], {})
+    assert await logger.ainfo("filtered") is None
+    assert await logger.alog(logging.INFO, "filtered") is None
+    assert backend.calls == []
